purpose: Teach: 念願/恐い/只今/ナイフ/マナー/水曜日/金持ち/ウソ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、念願、絶対、家族旅行、絶対、叶ったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, do you remember? When we were young, Dad's long-cherished dream about a family trip — it finally came true.
lines.style: Gentle opening, warm remembrance. Speak slowly, letting each memory land. Soft gaze into the past. Voice settling lower, like settling into a favourite chair.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、暗い夜道、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、恐い、絶対、と、絶対、感じたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. When we were young, those dark roads at night — I remember feeling so scared, don't you?
lines.style: A knowing laugh underneath. Slight edge, then softening. Acknowledge the worry without dwelling on it. Tone shifts from tense to tender mid-way through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、玄関で、絶対、只今、絶対、と、絶対、よく、絶対、声を、絶対、かけたぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Young days — your father would call out 'I'm home' at the entrance so often, remember Gran? It was always so warm.
lines.style: Nostalgic, almost reverie-like. Speak the greeting 'I'm home' with genuine warmth, as if hearing it again. Gentle pace. Let the memory breathe.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、お料理の、絶対、ナイフ、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、扱ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, and your grandfather — he handled his kitchen knife with such care and respect. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Quiet certainty, like reciting something sacred. Pause before 'knife' — the detail matters. Warm tone, almost protective of the memory. Voice steady and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、お孫さんに、絶対、マナー、絶対、しっかり、絶対、教えたぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father taught our grandchildren manners so carefully, Gran. You remember how seriously he took that, don't you?
lines.style: Measured, with quiet pride underneath. Emphasise the care in 'carefully' — it wasn't stern, it was loving. Voice carries conviction about what mattered.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、毎週、絶対、水曜日、絶対、お祖父ちゃんと、絶対、お買い物、絶対、行ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Every Wednesday when we were young, we'd go shopping with your grandfather. Don't you remember those days?
lines.style: Bright recall, almost sing-song. Gentle rhythm to match the routine. Warmth in 'every Wednesday' — the repetition held comfort. Voice close, intimate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、金持ち、絶対、ではないが、絶対、心は、絶対、豊かだったぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father wasn't wealthy, Gran, but his heart — his heart was so rich. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Pause before the turn to 'but' — let the contrast matter. Voice softens on 'heart' and lingers there. Speak with quiet conviction, almost like offering a truth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、ウソ、絶対、を、絶対、絶対、つかない、絶対、人だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather never lied, did he? He was the kind of person who wouldn't tell a lie. Do you remember?
lines.style: Intimate, close-spoken. Voice carries absolute certainty mixed with affection. Slight emphasis on 'never' — it's the core of who he was. Ending trails with warmth.
